uses.quote: Students must refer to the assignment brief for details on the use of generative artificial intelligence within assignments, and must acknowledge its use in line with this.
Where a student has made unauthorised use of generative artificial intelligence within their assessment and has attempted to gain an unfair advantage by passing this work off as their own.

Students who fail to follow the instructions in the assignment brief and attempt to gain an unfair advantage by passing off work produced by generative artificial intelligence as their own may be investigated for academic misconduct in line with this policy.

This does not apply to third parties such as Studiosity that have been sanctioned by the University to provide guidance and assistance to students in specific assessment situations, or where the generation of content using artificial intelligence (AI) has been expressly authorised as part of the assessment component.
The latter includes ‘hallucinated’ references, for example in instances where they have been generated by artificial intelligence.
